default.desc: Found: query typed, Find pressed, member card shown (the s07-int-find reference state)

en-INR.desc: Found, India dataset (no money on this screen; points only)

empty.desc: Empty: nothing typed, placeholder shown, no result (start of the video)

focus.desc: Query field focused with caret (cursor click on the input)

typing.desc: Query typed, Find not pressed yet (cursor target: Find)

loading.desc: Find pressed: button busy, result skeleton

sliding.desc: Result card mid slide-in (--la-progress 0.5 on find.result-slot; 0..1 driver)

zero.desc: Found member with 0 points balance (fresh programme)

error.desc: Error: Find pressed with an empty query (field validation message)
